thread:
maria: Starting a staged rollout for v2.14.0 -> EU @ 5% now. Change window 10:00-11:00 UTC. Release notes: https://git.company/release/v2.14.0 (pin: model=v2.14.0-rc3). Please monitor latency, 5xx, and KV cache evictions.

deploy-bot: [rollout-start] id=r-6011112222 region=eu percent=5 image=v2.14.0-rc3 user=maria

kevin: quick smoke: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~190ms (up ~10ms vs baseline), 5xx ~0.15% across the sample. no OOMs.

ops-oncall: thanks. can you share the dashboards you looked at? I'll watch alerts and the new tail-sampler.

kevin: dashboard -> https://telemetry.company/dashboards/rollout-quick-snap?run=6011112222

jon: rollback policy reminder: auto-trigger if 5xx >= 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 increase >= 50ms sustained 5m. Manual hold if KV cache evictions > 2% or node OOM.

cassie: small doc nit — release notes missing the migration step for the rate-limiter config. please add, otherwise LGTM.

maria: added migration note and bumped changelog. thanks cassie.

kevin: posting a short metric snippet:
```
metric.name: requests.5xx
window: 2m
value: 0.6%
notes: mostly 502 from an upstream that already had a brief blip, not rollout-correlated yet
```

ops-oncall: 0.6% is okay short term but watch the trajectory. if it trends upward to 1% I'll request a hold. I'm also watching kvcache.evictions (threshold 2%).

deploy-bot: [rollout-status] id=r-6011112222 percent=5 healthy=true nodes_updated=12 nodes_total=240 progress=5%

maria: heatcheck: i'm leaning to continue -> 20% in 15m if metrics remain flat. anyone object?

jon: +1 but watch embedding cost delta — we've seen tokenization regressions before with this branch. set an alert for embed.unit_cost>baseline*1.2

kevin: scheduled auto-bump to 20% in 15m if no holds. I'll annotate the run.

ops-oncall: ack. I'll step in to hold the rollout if 5xx >= 1% for 5m OR kvcache.evictions >= 2% for 3m. Post any infra anomalies here.

maria: thanks. tagging @deploy-bot to record policy notes.

deploy-bot: [annotation] id=r-6011112222 note="auto-bump-to-20pct-if-stable" scheduled_by=kevin eta=6011113322

cassie: reminder to update customer-facing release notes with the rate-limiter migration line before we hit 20%.

maria: done.

kevin: if nothing else, i'll trigger the 20% bump at +15. otherwise ops-oncall please call hold.

ops-oncall: I'll be monitoring and will post a hold if thresholds breach.

maria: thanks team — leaving this thread open for any quickholds. continuing monitoring. :rocket:
